It does not directly describe quota mixtures, deduplicated/without-replacement draws, repair, adaptive GP, variable-cost stopping or stochastic fitting merely represented by one stored score. Unknown support mass cannot be renormalized away. Algorithmic's broad any-policy/millisecond/guaranteed-improvement claims need these restrictions and measured scale evidence.
